profile.headline: Senior Development Developer at SoFi Technologies
profile.summary: IT professional with experience in design and development of financial applications. Strong software design, troubleshooting, problem resolution and leadership skills proven in high-pressure environments. Well developed interpersonal and communication skills.

positions.title: Senior Development Consultant
positions.description: Enhancement of remediation and developer tools; Statements and backdated interest calculation defect resolution, at Capital One.

positions.title: Senior Development Consultant
positions.locationName: Rehoboth Beach, Delaware, United States · Remote
positions.description:
January 2015 - February 2017: Profile development for Zenbanx including but not limited to:
. Anti-Money Laundering / Fraud algorithms
. Backdated Deposit Interest Processing
. Debit Card Processing
. Third-party Interfacing
. Data Scramble Utility

February 2017 - May 2024: Profile development for SoFI including but not limited to:
. Anti-Money Laundering / Fraud algorithms
. Customer On-boarding
. Person-to-Person Money Transfers
. Mobile Deposit Capture and Checks Interfacing
. External Account Methodology Conversion
. Multi-Dayend Test Utility
. Interest Calculation Utilities / Backdating Adjustments

positions.title: IT Architect Specialist
positions.description:
. Design lead, collaborating with multiple integrated systems (user interfaces, XPRESS) experts to architect new development projects
. Design specification reviewer and code reviewer for PROFILE system for both core and custom (large financial institutions)
. Large projects include Maker Checker and Interest Pooling
. Coding of more complex elements within projects

positions.title: Development Supervisor / Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
. Managed 10-14 developers in addition to handling technical duties before shifting focus solely to technical duties
· Estimated, designed plan of action, and coded second phase of several large and high-priority system areas on a massive database independence project
· Acted as code reviewer / owner of primary core banking system areas (such as Interest Accrual, Interest Posting, Transaction Posting), technical subject matter expert, and mentor
. Analyzed and implemented performance improvements to key areas of the system
· Served as mentor to external contractors, including travel to Bangalore, India for on-site training
· Designed, implemented and maintained multi-platform applications for large financial institutions worldwide; developed both real-time and batch processing systems on PROFILE application

positions.title: Application Programmer / Development Supervisor / Designer
positions.description:
. Participated in the full development lifecycle, starting with gathering requirements from the client, creating technical specifications, developing, testing and installing the end product (including travel to several international client sites)
· Supervised a group of between 4 and 7 application developers, and served as a technical /project lead on several large development projects
· Participated on code review committee whose purpose was to overhaul the company's code review methods / policies
. Revamped back-dated transaction processing (deposit) system to fix ongoing defects and drastically improve maintainability
· Re-designed major portion of back-dated transaction processing (lending) system to fully incorporate escrow (deposit) accounts

volunteerExperiences.description: Rewarding. It puts things in perspective and makes you realize just how lucky you are.
